title: Alignment Makes Language Models Normative, Not Descriptive
reasoning: The paper investigates 'normative bias' in LLMs, specifically examining how alignment processes like RLHF and DPO optimize models toward 'cooperative, fair, and socially appropriate' responses (normative ethics) rather than actually descriptive human behavior (which may involve bluffing or retaliation). It benchmarks these ethical and normative value systems against descriptive human behavioral data.
